hooks.name: Never edit an applied migration
hooks.description: After Kiro saves a SQL file under db/, warns when a migration that is already committed differs from HEAD. Flyway validates checksums at startup, so editing an applied migration stops the app on any database that ran it; new V<n>__ files are fine.

action.command: bad=""; for f in $(git diff --name-only HEAD -- src/main/resources/db 2>/dev/null); do git cat-file -e "HEAD:$f" 2>/dev/null && bad="$bad $f"; done; [ -z "$bad" ] && exit 0; printf "Edited an applied migration:%s\nFlyway checks migration checksums at startup, so a database that already ran it (Neon) refuses to start. Revert the edit and add V<n>__description.sql instead.\n" "$bad" >&2; exit 1
